Article 174  (1) If a person makes a purchase and sale of securities, market derivatives transaction, or over-the-counter derivatives transaction that is in violation of the provisions of Article 159, paragraph (1), offers to conduct such a transaction, or entrusts, etc. a person with conducting such a transaction (hereinafter the act is referred to as a "violation" and the person is referred to as a "violator" in this Article), the Prime Minister, in accordance with the procedures prescribed in the following Section, must order the violator to pay an administrative monetary penalty to the national treasury in an amount that is equivalent to the amount specified in the following items in accordance with the category of cases set forth in each of those items (or, if the violation falls under two or more cases set forth in the following items, the sum of the amounts specified in those items):
(i) during the period from the commencement of the violation to the end of the violation (hereinafter referred to as the "duration of the violation" in this Article), the volume of sales, etc. of securities that the violator makes on their own account for the securities, etc. (meaning securities or options, or financial instruments (other than securities) or financial indexes connected with derivatives transactions; hereinafter the same applies in this Article and the following Article) that are involved in the violation, exceeds the volume of purchases, etc. of securities that the violator makes on their own account for the securities, etc. that are involved in the violation: the amount arrived at when the amount set forth in (b) is deducted from the amount set forth in (a) (if the resulting amount is less than zero, the amount is to be zero):
(a) the value of the volume of sales, etc. of securities that is in excess;
(b) the amount arrived at when the lowest price for purchase, etc. of securities for the relevant securities, etc., from among the lowest prices prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 on each day in the period from the end of the violation until one month has elapsed since the violation has ended (if there is no such price, this means the price specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent to it, and the lowest price on the day on which the violation ends is the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order), is multiplied by the volume that is in excess;
(ii) during the duration of the violation, the volume of purchases, etc. of securities that the violator makes on their own account for the securities, etc. that are involved in the violation, exceeds the volume of sales, etc. of securities that the violator makes on their own account for the securities, etc. that are involved in the violation: the amount arrived at when the amount set forth in (b) below is deducted from the amount set forth in (a) below (if the resulting amount is less than zero, the amount is to be zero):
(a) the amount arrived at when the highest price for sale, etc. of securities for the relevant securities, etc., from among the highest prices as prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 on each day in the period from the end of the violation until one month has elapsed since the violation ended (if there is no such price, this means the price specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent to it and the highest price on the day on which the violation ends is the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order), is multiplied by the volume that is in excess;
(b) the value of the volume of purchases, etc. of securities that is in excess.
(iii) during the period from the commencement of the violation until one month has elapsed since the violation ended, the violator causes the securities involved in the violation which they or a person set forth in the items of paragraph (5) issues, to be acquired through a solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers the securities in a corporate reorganization: the amount arrived at when the amount set forth in (b) below is deducted from the amount set forth in (a) below (if the resulting amount is less than zero, the amount is to be zero):
(a) the amount arrived at when the highest securities purchase, etc. price for the securities that the violator causes to be acquired through the solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers in the corporate reorganization, from among the highest prices as prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 on each day in the period from the end of the violation until one month has elapsed since the violation ended (if there is no such price, this means the price specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent to it and the highest price on the day on which the violation ends is the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order), is multiplied by the volume of securities that the violator causes to be acquired through the solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers in the corporate reorganization;
(b) the amount arrived at when the price at the commencement of the violation for the securities that the violator causes to be acquired through the solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers in the corporate reorganization, is multiplied by the volume of securities that the violator causes to be acquired through the solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers in the coprporate reorganization;
(iv) during the period from the commencement of the violation until one month has elapsed since the violation ended, the violator commits a violation or makes a sale, etc. of securities or purchase, etc. of securities on the account of any person other than themselves: the amount specified in (a) or (b) in accordance with the category of the person that has committed the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities set forth in (a) or (b):
(a) a person that has committed the violation or has made the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities as an investment of property subject to investment: the amount obtained by multiplying by three, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as an amount equivalent to the consideration for investment of the property subject to investment which is specified by Cabinet Office Order in the month that includes the day of the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities (if the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities has been conducted over two or more months, the last month of those months); or
(b) a person other than the person set forth in (a): the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as the amount of fees, remuneration, or any other consideration for the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities.
(2) The term "sale, etc. of securities" as used in this Article means the sale of securities or commodities (in the case of commodities, limited to sales made through market derivatives transactions (limited to transactions set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (i))), a transaction set forth in item (ii) of that paragraph (limited to a transaction in which the violator is the party to pay the money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (iii) (limited to a transaction in which the relevant person is the party to grant the option), or any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(3) The term "purchase, etc. of securities" as used this Article means a purchase of securities or commodities (in the case of commodities, limited to purchase made through market derivatives transactions (limited to transactions set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (i))), a transaction set forth in item (ii) of that paragraph (limited to a transaction in which the violator is the party to receive money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (iii) (limited to a transaction in which the relevant person is the party to acquire the option), or any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(4) The term "value" as used in paragraph (1) means the amount arrived at when the price for sale, etc. of securities is multiplied by the volume of that sale, etc. or when the price for purchase, etc. of securities is multiplied by the volume of that purchase, etc.
(5) In the case referred to in paragraph (1), if the violator makes the sale, etc. of securities or purchase, etc. of securities on the account of a person set forth in any of the following items, the violator is deemed to have made the sale, etc. of securities or purchase, etc. of securities on their own account (if the person set forth in the relevant item commits the same violation as the violator, this excludes anything that constitutes the same sale, etc. of securities or purchase, etc. of securities as one that the person set forth in that item makes on their own account), and the provisions of the preceding paragraphs apply:
(i) a company in which the violator holds the majority of the voting rights held by all the shareholders, etc. or any other person specified by Cabinet Office Order as being closely related to the violator;
(ii) a person that shares living expenses with the violator, or any other person specified by Cabinet Office Order as having a unique relationship with the violator.
(6) For the purposes of calculating the amount set forth in the items of paragraph (1), if a violator has, at the time of the commencement of the violation, made sales of the securities or commodities subject to the violation without possessing those securities or commodities (in the case of commodities, limited to sales made through market derivatives transactions (limited to transactions set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (i))) on their own account or on the account of any person listed in the items of the preceding paragraph (excluding a person that has committed the same violation; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph), if the violator has, at the time of the commencement of the violation, concluded an agreement for a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) (limited to the transactions of securities or commodities subject to the violation) under which the person is obligated to pay money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure on their own account or on account of any person listed in the items of the preceding paragraph, or in any other cases specified by Cabinet Order, the violator is deemed to have made on their own account, the sales, etc. of securities at the time of the commencement of the violation and the price at that time.
(7) For the purposes of calculating the amounts set forth in the items of paragraph (1), if the violator posesses, at the time of the commencement of the violation, the securities or commodities involved in the violation, if the violator has, at the time of the commencement of the violation, agreed to conduct a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii), in which the violator will be the party to receive money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure (limited to a transaction of the securities or commodities involved in the violation) on their own account or on the account of a person set forth in any of the items of paragraph (5) (excluding a person that has committed the same violation); and in any other case specified by Cabinet Order; the violator is deemed to have made on the their own account, the purchase, etc. of securities at the time of the commencement of the violation and the price at that time.
(8) The amount set forth in the items of paragraph (1) is calculated for each issue of securities.
(9) If a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) is settled through the payment and receipt of money based on the actual figure, if the options on a transaction set forth in item (iii) of that paragraph extinguish without being exercised, and in any other case specified by Cabinet Order as being similar, the necessary particulars relevant to the calculation of the administrative monetary penalty referred to in paragraph (1) are specified by Cabinet Order.
(10) Beyond what is provided for in paragraph (2) through the preceding paragraph, the necessary particulars relevant to the calculation of the value of the sale, etc. of securities and the value of the purchase, etc. of securities provided for in paragraph (1), and necessary particulars otherwise relevant to the calculation of the administrative monetary penalty referred to in that paragraph are specified by Cabinet Order.
(Administrative Monetary Penalty Payment Order Issued to a Person That Makes a Series of Purchase and Sales of Securities for the Purpose of Inducing Transactions)
Article 174-2  (1) If a person mkaes a series of purchase and sales of securities, etc. (meaning purchase and sales of securities, etc. prescribed in Article 159, paragraph (2)) that is in violation of the provisions of Article 159, paragraph (2), item (i), offers to make such a series of purchase and sales, or entrusts, etc. a person with making such a series of purchase and sales (hereinafter the act is referred to as a "violation" and the person is referred to as the "violator" in this Article), the Prime Minister must, in accordance with the procedures prescribed in the following Section, order the violator to pay an administrative monetary penalty to the national treasury in an amount that is equivalent to the total of the amounts set forth in each of the following items (referred to as the "total amount" in paragraphs (10) and (11)):
(i) the amount arrived at when the amount set forth in (b) below is deducted from the amount set forth in (a) below:
(a) the value of the sales, etc. of securities on the violator's own account (limited to those connected with the volume of corresponding purchases or sales that is involved in the relevant violation);
(b) the value of the purchases, etc. of securities on the violator's own account (limited to those connected with the volume of corresponding purchases or sales that is involved in the relevant violation);
(ii) the amount specified in the following sub-items (a) through (d) in accordance with the category of cases set forth in the sub-items (a) through (d) (or, if the violation falls under two or more cases set forth in the following sub-items (a) through (d), the sum of the amounts specified in those two or more provisions of (a) through (d)):
(a) the volume of sales, etc. of securities on the violator's own account that are involved in the violation, exceeds the volume of purchases, etc. of securities on the violator's own account that are involved in violation: the amount arrived at when the amount specified in 2. below is deducted from the amount specified in 1. below (if the resulting amount is less than zero, the amount is to be zero):
1. the value of the volume of sales, etc. of securities that is in excess;
2. the amount arrived at when the lowest price for purchase, etc. of the securities, etc. involved in the violation, from among the lowest prices as prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 on each day in the period from the end of the violation until one month has elapsed since it ended (if there is no such price, this means the price specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent to it and the lowest price on the day on which the violation ends is the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order), is multiplied by the volume that is in excess;
(b) the volume of purchases, etc. of securities on the violator's own account that the violation involves, exceeds the volume of sales, etc. of securities on the violator's own account that the violation involves: the amount arrived at when the amount specified in 2. below is deducted from the amount specified in 1. below (if the resulting amount is less than zero, the amount is to be zero):
1. the amount arrived at when the highest price for sale, etc. of the securities, etc. involved in the violation, from among the highest prices as prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 on each day in the period from the end of the violation until one month has elapsed since the violation ended (if there is no such price, this means the price specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent to it; the highest price on the day on which the violation ends is the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order), is multiplied by the volume that is in excess;
2. the value of the volume of purchases, etc. of securities that is in excess;
(c) during the period from the commencement of the violation until one month has elapsed since the violation ended, the violator causes the securities involved in the violation that they or a person set forth in the items of paragraph (6) issues, to be acquired through a solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers such securities in a corporate reorganization: the amount arrived at when the amount specified in 2. below is deducted from the amount specified in 1. below (if the resulting amount is less than zero, it is deemed to be zero):
1. the amount arrived at when the highest securities purchase, etc. price for the securities that the violator causes to be acquired through the solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers in the corporate reorganization, from among the highest prices as prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 on each day in the period from the end of the violation until one month has elapsed since it ended (if there is no such price, this means the price specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent to it and the highest price on the day on which the violation ends is the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order), is multiplied by the volume of securities that the violator causes to be acquired through the solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers in the corporate reorganization;
2. the amount arrived at when the price at the commencement of the violation for the securities that the violator causes to be acquired through the solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers in the corporate reorganization, is multiplied by the volume of securities that the violator causes to be acquired through the solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers in the corporate reorganization;
(d) during the period from the commencement of the violation until one month has elapsed since the violation ended, the violator commits a violation or makes a sales, etc. of securities or purchase, etc. of securities on the account of any person other than themselves: the amount specified in 1. or 2. below in accordance with the category of the person that has conducted the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities set forth in 1. or 2.:
1. a person that has committed the violation or has made the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities as an investment of property subject to investment: the amount obtained by multiplying by three, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as an amount equivalent to the consideration for investment of the property subject to investment which is specified by Cabinet Office Order in the month that includes the day of the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities (if the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities has been conducted over two or more months, the last month of those months); or
2. a person other than the person set forth in 1.: the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as the amount of fees, remuneration, or any other consideration for the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities.
(2) The term "sale, etc.of securities" as used in this Article means the sale of securities or commodities (in the case of commodities, limited to sales made through market derivatives transactions (limited to transactions set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (i))), a transaction set forth in item (ii) of that paragraph (limited to a transaction in which the violator is the party to pay the money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (iii) (limited to a transaction in which the relevant person is the party to grant the option), or any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(3) The term "purchase, etc. of securities" as used this Article means a purchase of securities or commodities (in the case of commodities, limited to purchase made through market derivatives transactions (limited to transactions set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (i))), a transaction set forth in item (ii) of that paragraph (limited to a transaction in which the violator is the party to receive the money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (iii) (limited to a transaction in which the relevant person is the party to acquire the option), or any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(4) The term "volume of corresponding purchases and sales" as used in paragraph (1), item (i) means either the volume of sales, etc. of securities on the violator's own account that are involved in the violation, or the volume of purchases, etc. of securities on the violator's own account that are involved in the violation, whichever is smaller.
(5) The term "value" as used in paragraph (1) means the amount arrived at when the price for sale, etc. of securities is multiplied by the volume of that sale, etc. or when the price for purchase, etc. of securities is multiplied by the volume of that purchase, etc.
(6) In the case referred to in paragraph (1), if the violator commits the violation or makes the sale, etc. of securities or purchase, etc. of securities on the account of a person set forth in any of the following items, the violator is deemed to have committed the violation or made the sale, etc. of securities or purchase, etc. of securities on their own account (if the person set forth in the relevant item commits the same violation as the violator, this excludes anything that constitutes the same sale, etc. of securities or purchase, etc. of securities as one that the person set forth in that item makes on their own account), and the provisions of the preceding paragraphs apply:
(i) a company in which the violator holds the majority of the voting rights held by all the shareholders, etc., or any other person specified by Cabinet Office Order as being closely related to the violator;
(ii) a person that shares living expenses with the violator, or any other person specified by Cabinet Office Order as having a unique relationship with the violator.
(7) For the purposes of calculating the amount listed in the items of paragraph (1), if a violator has, at the time of the commencement of the violation, made the sales of the securities or commodities subject to a violation without possessing those securities or commodities (in the case of commodities, limited to sales conducted through market derivatives transactions (limited to transactions set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (i))), on their own account or on the account of any person listed in the items of the preceding paragraph (excluding a person that has committed the same violation; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph), if the violator has, at the time of the commencement of the violation, concluded an agreement for the transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) (limited to the transactions of securities or commodities subject to the relevant violation) under which the person is obligated to pay money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure on their own account or on the account of any person listed in the items of the preceding paragraph, or in any other cases specified by Cabinet Order, the relevant violator is deemed to have made on their own account, the sales, etc. of securities subject to the violation at the time of the commencement of the violation and the price at that time.
(8) For the purposes of calculating the amount set forth in the items of paragraph (1), if the violator possesses, at the time of the commencement of the violation, the securities or commodities involved in the violation, if the violator has, at the time of the commencement of the violation, agreed to conduct a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii), in which the violator will be the party to receive money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure (limited to a transaction of the securities or commodities involved in the violation) on their account or on the account of a person set forth in any of the items of paragraph (5) (excluding a person that has committed the same violation), and in any other case specified by Cabinet Order, the violator is deemed to have made the purchase, etc. of securities on their own account at the time of the commencement of the violation and the price at that time.
(9) The amounts set forth in the items of paragraph (1) are calculated for each issue of securities.
(10) If a negative amount arises from the deduction set forth in paragraph (1), item (i) for a single issue, the total amount is the amount arrived at when that negative amount is deducted from the amount specified in item (ii) of that paragraph for the same issue.
(11) If there are two or more issues connected with a violation and the amount for any of those issues is still negative even after a deduction is made pursuant to the provisions of the preceding paragraph, the negative amount is deducted from the total amount for other issues.
(12) If a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) is settled through the payment and receipt of money based on the actual figure; if the options on a transaction set forth in item (iii) of that paragraph extinguish without being exercised; and in any other case specified by Cabinet Order as being similar; the necessary particulars relevant to the calculation of the administrative monetary penalty referred to in paragraph (1) are specified by Cabinet Order.
(13) Beyond what is provided for in paragraph (2) through the preceding paragraph, the necessary particulars relevant to the calculation of the value of the sale, etc. of securities and the value of the purchase, etc. of securities provided for in paragraph (1), and necessary particulars otherwise relevant to the calculation of the administrative monetary penalty referred to in that paragraph are specified by Cabinet Order.
(Administrative Monetary Penalty Payment Order Issued to a Person Violating the Prohibition on Stabilizing Transactions)
Article 174-3  (1) If a person makes a series of purchase and sales of securities, etc. that is in violation of the provisions of Article 159, paragraph (3) (meaning purchase and sales of securities, etc. prescribed in paragraph (2) of that Article), or offers to make such a series of purchase and sales or entrusts, etc. a person with effecting such a series of purchase and sales (hereinafter the act is referred to as a "violation" and the person is referred to as the "violator" in this Article), the Prime Minister must, in accordance with the procedures prescribed in the following Section, order the violator to pay an administrative monetary penalty to the national treasury in an amount that is equivalent to the sum of the amounts specified in each of the following items (referred to as the "total amount" in paragraphs (11) and (12)):
(i) the amount arrived at when the amount specified in (b) below is deducted from the amount specified in (a) below:
(a) the value of the sales, etc. of securities on the violator's own account that the violation involves;
(b) the value of the purchases, etc. of securities on the violator's own account that the violation involves;
(ii) the amount specified in the following sub-items (a) through (d) in accordance with the category of cases set forth in the sub-items (a) through (d) (or, if the violation falls under two or more cases set forth in the following sub-items (a) through (d), the sum of the amounts specified in those two or more provisions of (a) through (d)):
(a) at the time of the commencement of the violation, the violator's sales volume, etc. in respect of the listed financial instruments, etc. (meaning listed financial instruments, etc. prescribed in Article 159, paragraph (2), item (i); hereinafter the same applies in this Article) or over-the-counter traded securities involved in the violation exceeds the violator's purchase volume, etc. of the over-the-counter traded securities: the amount arrived at when the amount specified in 2. below is deducted from the amount specified in 1. below, and the difference is multiplied by the volume specified in 3. below (if the resulting amount is less than zero, the amount is deemed to be zero):
1. the price for purchase, etc. of securities for the listed financial instruments, etc. or over-the-counter traded securities after the violation (meaning the average price during the period from the end of the violation until one month has elapsed since the violation ended, calculated pursuant to the provisions of Cabinet Office Order; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph);
2. the price for purchase, etc. of securities for the listed financial instruments, etc. or over-the-counter traded securities, during the violation (meaning the average price during the period from the commencement of the violation until the violation ends, calculated pursuant to the provisions of Cabinet Office Order; hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph);
3. the volume that is in excess;
(b) at the time of the commencement of the violation, the violator's purchase volume, etc. in respect of the listed financial instruments, etc. or over-the-counter traded securities involved in the violation exceeds the violator's sales volume, etc. of the over-the-counter traded securities: the amount arrived at when the amount specified in 2. below is deducted from the amount specified in 1. below, and the difference is multiplied by the volume specified in 3. below (if the resulting amount is less than zero, the amount is deemed to be zero):
1. the price for sale, etc. of securities for the relevant listed financial instruments, etc. or the over-the-counter traded securities, during the violation;
2. the price for sale, etc. of securities for the relevant listed financial instruments, etc. or the over-the-counter traded securities, after the violation;
3. the volume that is in excess;
(c) during the period from the commencement of the violation until one month has elapsed since the violation ended, the violator causes the securities involved in the violation that they or a person with a specified relationship issues, to be acquired through a solicitation with a view to issuing new securities, or delivers those securities in a corporate reorganization: the amount arrived at when the amount set forth in 2. is deducted from the amount set forth in 1., and the difference is multiplied by the volume set forth in 3. (if the resulting amount is less than zero, the amount is to be zero):
1. the price, during the violation, of the securities that the violator causes to be acquired through the solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers in the corporate reorganization;
2. the price, after the violation, of the securities that the violator causes to be acquired through the solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers in the corporate reorganization;
3. the volume of securities that the violator causes to be acquired through the solicitation with a view to issuing new securities or delivers in the corporate reorganization;
(d) during the period from the commencement of the violation until one month has elapsed since the violation ended, the violator commits a violation or makes a sales, etc. of securities, or purchase, etc. securities on the account of any person other than themselves: (excluding persons in a specified relationship): the amount specified in 1. or 2. in accordance with the category of the person that has conducted the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities set forth in 1. or 2.:
1. a person that has conducted the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities as an investment of property subject to investment: the amount obtained by multiplying by three, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as an amount equivalent to the consideration for investment of the property subject to investment which is specified by Cabinet Office Order in the month that includes the day of the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities (if the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities has been conducted over two or more months, the last month of those months); or
2. a person other than the person set forth in 1.: the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as the amount of fees, remuneration, or any other consideration for the violation, the sales, etc. of securities or the purchase, etc. of securities.
(2) The term "sale, etc. of securities" as used in this Article means the sale of securities or commodities (in the case of commodities, limited to sales made through market derivatives transactions (limited to transactions set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (i))), a transaction set forth in item (ii) of that paragraph (limited to a transaction in which the violator is the party to pay the money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (iii) (limited to a transaction in which the relevant person is the party to grant the option), or any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(3) The term "purchase, etc. of securities" as used this Article means a purchase of securities or commodities (in the case of commodities, limited to purchase made through market derivatives transactions (limited to transactions set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (i))), a transaction set forth in item (ii) of that paragraph (limited to a transaction in which the violator is the party to receive the money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (iii) (limited to a transaction in which the relevant person is the party to acquire the option), or any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(4) The term "value" as used in paragraph (1), item (i) means the amount arrived at when the price for sale, etc. of securities is multiplied by the volume of that sale, etc. or when the price for purchase, etc. of securities is multiplied by the volume of that purchase, etc.
(5) The term "volume of sales, etc." as used in this Article means the volume of the securities or commodities related to the transactions which the violator, on their own account or on the account of the persons in specified relationship, has made the sales, etc. of securities or commodities without possessing the securities or commodities (in the case of commodities, limited to sales made through market derivatives transactions (limited to transactions set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (i))) or any other transactions specified by Cabinet Order; or the volume of the transaction set forth in item (ii) of that paragraph (limited to the transaction in which the person becomes a party paying money when the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure) which the violator has conducted on their own account or on the account of the persons in specified relationship or any other transactions specified by Cabinet Order, as calculated pursuant to the provisions of Cabinet Order.
(6) The term "purchase volume, etc." as used in this Article means the volume of the securities or commodities that the violator or a person with a specified relationship possesses or any other securities or commodities specified by Cabinet Order as being equivalent to them, and the volume calculated pursuant to the provisions of Cabinet Order as the volume of a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) (limited to a transaction in which the violator is the party to receive money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure) or any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order, which the violator agrees to conduct on their own account or on the account of a person with a specified relationship.
(7) The term "person with a specified relationship" as used in this Article means any of the following persons:
(i) a company in which the violator holds the majority of the voting rights held by all of the shareholders, etc. or any other person specified by Cabinet Office Order as being closely related to the violator;
(ii) a person that shares living expenses with the violator, or any other person specified by Cabinet Office Order as having a unique relationship with the violator.
(8) If a person with a specified relationship has committed the same violation as that committed by the violator, the following volume is excluded from the volume of sales, etc.: the volume of the securities or commodities related to the transactions in which, at the time of the commencement of the violation and with regard to the listed financial instruments, etc. or the over-the-counter traded securities subject to the violation, the person with a specified relationship has conducted sales of the securities or commodities or any transaction specified by Cabinet Order on their own account without possessing the securities or commodities (in the case of commodities, limited to sale made through market derivatives transactions (limited to transactions set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (i))); or the volume of the transactions calculated pursuant to the provisions of Cabinet Order, in which, at the time of the commencement of the violation and with regard to the listed financial instruments, etc. or the over-the-counter traded securities subject to the violation, the person with a specified relationship has, on their own account, conducted the transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) (limited to the transaction in which the person becomes a party to pay money when the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure) or any other transactions specified by Cabinet Order.
(9) If a person with a specified relationship commits the same violation as the violator, the volume of the securities or commodities that the person with the specified relationship possesses, and any other securities or commodities specified by Cabinet Order as being equivalent to them at the time of the commencement of the violation, in respect of the listed financial instruments or over-the-counter traded securities involved in the violation and the volume calculated pursuant to the provisions of Cabinet Order as the volume of a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) (limited to a transaction in which the person with the specified relationship is the party to receive money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure) or any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order in respect of the listed financial instruments, etc. or over-the-counter traded securities involved in the violation in which the person with the specified relationship has agreed to conduct on their own account, is to be deducted from the purchase volume, etc.
(10) The amount set forth in the items of paragraph (1) are calculated for each issue of securities.
(11) If a negative amount arises from the deduction set forth in paragraph (1), item (i) for a single issue, the total amount is the amount arrived at when the negative amount is deducted from the amount specified in item (ii) of that paragraph for the same issue.
(12) If there are two or more issues connected with a violation and the amount for any of those issues is still negative even after a deduction is made pursuant to the provisions of the preceding paragraph, the negative amount is deducted from the total amount for other issues.
(13) If a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) is settled through the payment and receipt of money based on the actual figure, if the options on a transaction set forth in item (iii) of that paragraph extinguish without being exercised; and in any other case specified by Cabinet Order as being similar, the necessary particulars relevant to the calculation of the administrative monetary penalty referred to in paragraph (1) are specified by Cabinet Order.
(14) Beyond what is provided for in paragraph (2) through the preceding paragraph, the necessary particulars relevant to the calculation of the value of the sale, etc. of securities and the value of the purchase, etc. of securities provided for in paragraph (1), item (i), and necessary particulars otherwise relevant to the calculation of the administrative monetary penalty referred to in that paragraph are specified by Cabinet Order.
(Administrative Monetary Penalty Payment Order Issued to a Person That Violates Acts Prohibited for Company Insiders)
Article 175  (1) If a person violates the provisions of Article 166 paragraph (1) or (3) in making a purchase and sale, etc. prescribed in Article 166 paragraph (1), the Prime Minister must, in accordance with the procedures prescribed in the following Section, order that person to pay an administrative monetary penalty to the national treasury in an amount that is equivalent to the amount specified in the following items in accordance with the category of cases set forth in each of those items (or, if the violation falls under two or more cases set forth in the following items, the sum of the amounts specified in those two or more items):
(i) the person violates the provisions of Article 166, paragraph (1) or (3) in making a sale, etc. of securities on their own account (limited to one made within six months prior to the date on which a material fact about the business that is provided for in Article 166, paragraph (1) is publicized (excluding a sale, etc. of securities on the date of the publicization which is made after the the material fact is publicized); hereinafter the same applies in this item): the amount arrived at when the amount specified in (b) below is deducted from the amount specified in (a) below:
(a) the amount arrived at when the price at which the person made the sale, etc. of securities is multiplied by the volume of that securities sale, etc.;
(b) the amount arrived at when the lowest price during the two weeks after the material fact about the business, etc. is publicized, is multiplied by the volume of that sale, etc. of securities;
(ii) the person violates the provisions of Article 166, paragraph (1) or (3) in making a purchase, etc. of securities on their own account (limited to one made within six months prior to the date on which the material fact about the business, etc. set forth in Article 166, paragraph (1) is publicized (excluding a purchase, etc. of securities on the date of publicization which is made after the material fact is publicized); hereinafter the same applies in this item): the amount arrived at when the amount specified in (b) below is deducted from the amount specified in (a) below:
(a) the amount arrived at when the highest price during the two weeks after the material fact about the business, etc. is publicized, is multiplied by the volume of that purchase, etc. of securities;
(b) the amount arrived at when the price at which the person made the purchase, etc. of securities, is multiplied by the volume of that purchase, etc. of securities;
(iii) the person that makes a purchase and sale, etc. as prescribed in Article 166, paragraph (1) has made that purchase and sale, etc. on the account of any person other than themselves (excluding the cases in which an officer, etc. prescribed in paragraph (9) has made the purchase and sale, etc. referred to in that paragraph): the amount arrived at when the price for the purchase, etc. of securities made is multiplied by the volume of that purchase, etc.:
(a) a person that has made the purchase and sale, etc. as an investment of property subject to investment: the amount obtained by multiplying by three, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as an amount equivalent to the consideration for investment of the property subject to investment which is specified by Cabinet Office Order in the month that includes the day of the purchase and sale, etc. (in cases where the purchase and sale, etc. has been conducted over two or more months, the last month of those months); or
(b) a person other than the person set forth in (a): the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as the amount of fees, remuneration, or any other consideration for the purchase and sale, etc.
(2) If a person violates the provisions of Article 167, paragraph (1) or (3) in making a purchase, etc. involving the specified share certificates, etc. or related share certificates, etc. prescribed in Article 167, paragraph (1) or a sale, etc. involving the share certificates, etc. prescribed in that paragraph, the Prime Minister must, in accordance with the procedures prescribed in the following Section, order that person to pay an administrative monetary penalty to the national treasury in an amount that is equivalent to the amount specified in the following items in accordance with the category of cases set forth in each of those items (or, if the violation falls under two or more cases set forth in the following items, the sum of the amounts specified in those two or more items):
(i) the person violates the provisions of Article 167, paragraph (1) or (3) in making a sale, etc. of securities on their own account (limited to one made within six months prior to the date on which the fact that a tender offer, etc. will be launched or of the fact that a tender offer, etc. will be suspended as provided in Article 167, paragraph (1) is disclosed (excluding a sale, etc. of securities on the date of disclosure which is made after the fact is disclosed); hereinafter the same applies in this item): the amount arrived at when the amount specified in (b) below is deducted from the amount specified in (a) below:
(a) the amount arrived at when the price at which the person made the sale, etc. of securities is multiplied by the volume of that sale, etc.;
(b) the amount arrived at when the lowest price during the two weeks after the disclosure of the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be launched or of the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be suspended, for that sale, etc. of securities is multiplied by the volume of that sale, etc.;
(ii) the person violates the provisions of Article 167, paragraph (1) or (3) in making a purchase, etc. of securities on their own account (limited to one made within six months prior to the date on which the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be launched or the fact that a tender offer, etc. will be suspended as provided in Article 167, paragraph (1) is disclosed (excluding a purchase, etc. of securities on the date of disclosure which is made after the fact is disclosed); hereinafter the same applies in this item): the amount arrived at when the amount specified in (b) below is deducted from the amount specified in (a) below:
(a) the amount arrived at when the highest price during the two weeks after the disclosure of the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be launched or the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be suspended for that purchase, etc. of securities is multiplied by the volume of that purchase, etc.;
(b) the amount arrived at when the price at which the person made the purchase, etc. of securities is multiplied by the volume of that purchase, etc.;
(iii) the person that makes a purchase, etc. of the specified share certificates, etc. or related share certificates, etc. prescribed in Article 167, paragraph (1), or a sale, etc. of the share certificates, etc. prescribed in that paragraph, makes that purchase, etc. or sale, etc. on the account of any person other than themselves: the amount specified in (a) or (b) below in accordance with the category of the person that has made the purchase, etc. or sales, etc. set forth in (a) or (b):
(a) a person that has made the purchase, etc. or sales, etc. as an investment of property subject to investment: the amount obtained by multiplying by three, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as an amount equivalent to the consideration for investment of the property subject to investment which is specified by Cabinet Office Order in the month that includes the day of the purchase, etc. or sales, etc. (in cases where the purchase, etc. or sales, etc. has been made over two or more months, the last month of those months); or
(b) a person other than the person set forth in (a): the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as the amount of fees, remuneration, or any other consideration for the purchase, etc. or sales, etc.
(3) The term "sale, etc. of securities" as used in the preceding two paragraphs means the sale of securities, a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) (limited to a transaction in which the violator is the party to pay the money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (iii) (limited to a transaction in which the relevant person is the party to grant the option), or any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(4) The term "purchase, etc. of securities" as used in paragraphs (1) and (2) means a purchase of securities, a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) (limited to a transaction in which the relevant person is the party to receive the money if the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (iii) (limited to a transaction in which the relevant person is the party to acquire the option), or any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(5) The term "lowest price in the two weeks after the disclosure of the material fact about the business" as used in paragraph (1), item (i), (b) means the lowest price from among the lowest prices prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 on each day in the period from the day on which a material fact about business which is provided for in Article 166, paragraph (1) is disclosed until two weeks have elapsed since it was disclosed (if there is no such price, this means the price specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent to it and the lowest price on the day on which the material fact is disclosed is the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order).
(6) The term "highest price in the two weeks after the disclosure of the material fact about the business" as used in paragraph (1), item (i), (a) means the highest price among the highest prices prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 on each day in the period from the day on which a material fact about business which is provided for in Article 166, paragraph (1) is disclosed until two weeks have elapsed since it was disclosed (if there is no such price, this means the price specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent to it and the highest price on the day on which the material fact is disclosed is the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order).
(7) The term "lowest price in the two weeks after the disclosure of the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be launched or the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be suspended" as used in paragraph (2), item (i), (b) means the lowest price from among the lowest prices prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 on each day in the period from the day on which the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be launched or of the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be suspended as provided in Article 167, paragraph (1) is disclosed until two weeks have elapsed since it was disclosed (if there is no such price, this means the price specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent to it and the lowest price on the day on which the fact is disclosed is the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order).
(8) The term "highest price in the two weeks after the disclosure of the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be launched or the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be suspended " as used in paragraph (2), item (ii), (a) means the highest among the highest prices prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 on each day in the period from the day on which the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be launched or the fact that the tender offer, etc. will be suspended as provided in Article 167, paragraph (1) is disclosed until two weeks have elapsed since it was disclosed (if there is no such price, this means the price specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent to it and the highest price on the day on which the fact is disclosed is the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order).
(9) The provisions of paragraph (1) (excluding item (iii)) apply mutatis mutandis if the officer, etc., prescribed in Article 166, paragraph (1), item (i), of a listed company, etc. (meaning a listed company, etc. prescribed in Article 163, paragraph (1), and including a parent company, subsidiary company, asset management company, and specified associated corporation prescribed in Article 166, paragraph (1), item (i); the same applies in paragraph (13) of the following Article) violates the provisions of Article 166, paragraph (1) or (3) in making a purchase and sale, etc. prescribed in Article 166, paragraph (1) on the account of that listed company, etc. In this case, the term "person" in paragraph (1) is deemed to be replaced with "listed company, etc.", and the phrase "on its own account" in items (i) and (ii) of that paragraph is deemed to be replaced with "on the account of the listed company, etc."
(10) In the case referred to in paragraph (1), a person that makes a purchase and sale, etc. prescribed in Article 166, paragraph (1) on the account of a person set forth in any of the following items is deemed to have made that purchase and sale, etc. on their own account (if the person set forth in the items of that paragraph makes a purchase and sale, etc. prescribed in paragraph (1) of that Article in violation of the provisions of paragraph (1) or (3) of that Article on their own account, excluding the same purchase and sale, etc. as that purchase and sale, etc.), and the provisions of paragraph (1) apply:
(i) a company in which the person that makes the purchase and sale, etc. holds the majority of the voting rights held by all of the shareholders, etc., or any other person specified by Cabinet Office Order as being closely related to the person that makes that purchase and sale, etc.;
(ii) a person that shares living expenses with the person that makes the purchase and sale, etc., or any other person specified by Cabinet Office Order as having a unique relationship with the person that makes that purchase and sale, etc.
(11) In the case referred to in paragraph (2), a person that makes a purchase, etc. of the specified share certificates, etc. or the related share certificates, etc. prescribed in Article 167, paragraph (1) or a sale, etc. of the share certificates, etc. prescribed in that paragraph on the account of a person set forth in any of the following items, is deemed to have made that purchase, etc. or sale, etc. on their own account (if the person set forth in the items of that Article has violated the provisions of paragraph (1) or (3) of that Article in making a purchase, etc. of the specified share certificates, etc. or the related share certificates, etc. prescribed in paragraph (1) of that Article or a sale, etc. of the share certificates, etc. prescribed in that paragraph on their own account, excluding the same purchase, etc. or sale, etc. as that purchase, etc. or sale, etc.), and the provisions of paragraph (2) apply:
(i) a company in which the person that makes the purchase and sale, etc. holds the majority of the voting rights held by all of the shareholders, etc., or any other person specified by Cabinet Office Order as being closely related to the person that makes the purchase, etc. or sale, etc.;
(ii) a person that shares living expenses with the person that makes the purchase, etc. or sale, etc., or any other person specified by Cabinet Office Order as having a unique relationship with the person that makes the purchase, etc. or sale, etc.
(12) Beyond what is prescribed in paragraphs (3) through (8) and the preceding two paragraphs, if the sale, etc. of securities or purchase, etc. of securities provided for in paragraph (1) (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (9); hereinafter the same applies in this paragraph) and paragraph (2) constitutes a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii), the price and volume and other necessary particulars relevant to calculation of the administrative monetary penalty referred to in paragraph (1) or (2) are specified by Cabinet Order.
(Administrative Monetary Penalty Payment Order Issued to a Person That Has Violated the Prohibition on Providing Information on Unpublished Material Facts)
Article 175-2  (1) When a person has, in violation of the provisions of Article 167-2, paragraph (1), perdformed the act of providing information set forth in that paragraph or recommending the purchase and sale, etc. set forth in that paragraph (hereinafter the act is referred to as a "violation" and the person is referred to as the "violator" in this paragraph), the Prime Minister must, in accordance with the procedures prescribed in the following Section, order the violator to pay an administrative monetary penalty to the national treasury in an amount that is equivalent to the amount prescribed in the following items in accordance with the category of the cases set forth in each of those items only when the person that has received information or the person that has been recommended to make the purchase and sale, etc. by the violation (hereinafter referred to as the "information recipient, etc." in this paragraph and paragraph (3)) makes the purchase and sale, etc. of regulated securities, etc. related to the violation before the disclosure set forth in Article 166, paragraph (1) is made with regard to the material facts related to business or other particulars prescribed in that paragraph related to the violation (excluding cases that fall under the cases set forth in the items of paragraph (6) of that Article):
(i) when the violation has been committed in relation to business related to the acts set forth in Article 2, paragraph (8), item (ii) or (iii), the acts set forth in item (iv) of that paragraph (excluding over-the-counter derivatives transactions), the acts listed in item (x) of that paragraph (excluding purchase and sale of securities), or acts specified by Cabinet Order as being equivalent to them (including acts specified by Cabinet Office Order as business incidental to them; hereinafter referred to as "intermediation-related business" in this paragraph and the following paragraph) concerning regulated securities, etc. (excluding the case specified in the following item): the amount obtained by multiplying by three, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as an amount equivalent to the consideration for intermediation-related business in the month that includes the day of the violation (if the violation has been committed over two or more months, the last month of those months) to be paid by the information recipient, etc. to the violator;
(ii) when the violation has been committed in relation to business related to the acts set forth in Article 2, paragraph (8), item (ix) concerning regulated securities, etc. (hereinafter referred to as "business of public offering, etc." in this item, item (ii) of the following paragraph, and Article 185-7, paragraphs (xii) and (xiii)): the sum of the amounts listed in (a) and (b):
(a) the amount obtained by multiplying by three, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as an amount equivalent to the consideration for intermediation-related business in the month that includes the day of the violation (if the violation has been committed over two or more months, the last month of those months) to be paid by the information recipient, etc. to the violator; and
(b) the amount obtained by multiplying by one-half, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as an amount equivalent to the consideration for the business of public offering, etc. and the business related to the acts set forth in Article 2, paragraph (8), item (vi) performed together with the business of public offering, etc.; and
(iii) cases other than those set forth in the preceding two items: the amount obtained by multiplying by one-half, the amount equivalent to the profit obtained from the purchase and sale, etc. made by the information recipient, etc. through the violation.
(2) When a person has, in violation of the provisions of Article 167-2, paragraph (2), performed the act of providing information set forth in that paragraph or recommending the purchase, etc. or the sales, etc. set forth in that paragraph (hereinafter the act is referred to as a "violation" and the person is referred to as the "violator" in this paragraph), the Prime Minister must, in accordance with the procedures prescribed in the following Section, order the violator to pay to the national treasury an administrative monetary penalty equivalent to the amount as prescribed in the following items in accordance with the category of the cases listed in each of those items only when the person that has received information or the person that has been recommended to make the purchase, etc. or the sales, etc. by the violation (hereinafter referred to as the "information recipient, etc." in this paragraph and paragraph (4)) makes the purchase, etc. or the sales, etc. of share certificates, etc. related to the violation before the publication set forth in Article 167, paragraph (1) is made with regard to the fact concerning tender offer, etc. related to the violation (excluding cases that fall under the cases set forth in the items of paragraph (5) of the Article):
(i) when the violation has been committed in relation to intermediation-related business related to share certificates, etc. (excluding the case set forth in the following item): the amount obtained by multiplying, by three, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as an amount equivalent to the consideration for intermediation-related business in the month that includes the day of the violation (if the violation has been committed over two or more months, the last month of those months) to be paid by the information recipient, etc. to the violator;
(ii) when the violation has been committed in relation to business of public offering, etc. related to the share certificates, etc.: the sum of the amounts listed in (a) and (b):
(a) the amount obtained by multiplying by three, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as an amount equivalent to the consideration for intermediation-related business in the month that includes the day of the violation (if the violation has been committed over two or more months, the last month of those months) to be paid by the information recipient, etc. to the violator; and
(b) the amount obtained by multiplying by one-half, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order as an amount equivalent to the consideration for the business of public offering, etc. and the business related to the acts set forth in Article 2, paragraph (8), item (vi) conducted together with the business of public offering, etc.; and
(iii) cases other than those set forth in the preceding two items: the amount obtained by multiplying by one-half, the amount equivalent to the profit obtained from the purchase, etc. or the sales, etc. made by the information recipient, etc. through the violation.
(3) The term "amount equivalent the to profit" as used in paragraph (1), item (iii) means the amount prescribed in the following items in accordance with the category of the cases set forth in each of those items (if the information recipient, etc. falls under both of the following items, the sum of the amounts prescribed in those items):
(i) when the information recipient, etc. has made sales, etc. of regulated securities, etc.: the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in (b) below from the amount set forth in (a) below:
(a) the amount obtained by multiplying the price for the sales, etc. of the regulated securities, etc. by the volume of the sales, etc. of the regulated securities, etc.; and
(b) the amount obtained by multiplying the lowest price during the two weeks after the disclosure set forth in paragraph (1) is made with regard to the sales, etc. of regulated securities, etc. by the volume of the sales, etc. of regulated securities, etc.;
(ii) when the information recipient, etc. has made a purchase, etc. of regulated securities, etc.: the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in (b) below from the amount set forth in (a) below:
(a) the amount obtained by multiplying the highest price during the two weeks after the disclosure set forth in paragraph (1) with regard to the purchase, etc. of regulated securities, etc. is made by the volume of the purchase, etc. of regulated securities, etc.; and
(b) the amount obtained by multiplying the price for the purchase, etc. of regulated securities, etc. by the volume of the purchase, etc. of the regulated securities;
(4) The term "amount equivalent to the profit" as used in paragraph (2), item (iii) means the amount prescribed in the following items in accordance with the category of the cases set forth in each of those items (if the information recipient, etc. falls under both of the following items, the sum of the amounts prescribed in those items):
(i) when the information recipient, etc. has made sales, etc. of share certificates, etc.: the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in (b) below from the amount set forth in (a) below:
(a) the amount obtained by multiplying the price for the sales, etc. of the share certificates, etc. by the volume of the sales, etc. of the share certificates; and
(b) the amount obtained by multiplying the lowest price during the two weeks after the disclosure set forth in paragraph (2) with regard to the sales, etc. of the share certificates, etc. is made by the volume of the sales, etc. of the share certificates, etc.;
(ii) when the information recipient, etc. has made a purchase, etc. of share certificates, etc.: the amount obtained by deducting the amount set forth in (b) below from the amount set forth in (a) below:
(a) the amount obtained by multiplying the highest price during the two weeks after the disclosure set forth in paragraph (2) with regard to the purchase, etc. of the share certificates, etc. is made by the volume of the purchase, etc. of the share certificates, etc.; and
(b) the amount obtained by multiplying the price for the purchase, etc. of the share certificates, etc. by the volume of the purchase, etc. of the share certificates, etc.
(5) The term "sales, etc. of regulated securities, etc." as used in paragraph (3), item (i) means sales of regulated securities, etc., a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) (limited to a transaction in which the person becomes the party to pay money when the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in item (iii) of that paragraph (limited to the transaction in which the person becomes a party to grant options) and any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(6) The term "lowest price during the two weeks after the disclosure set forth in paragraph (1)" as used in paragraph (3), item (i), (b) means the lowest price among the lowest prices prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 for each day in the period between the day the disclosure set forth in paragraph (1) is made and the day two weeks have elapsed from the disclosure (when there is no such price, what is specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent, and for the day of the disclosure, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order).
(7) The term "purchase, etc. of regulated securities, etc." as used in paragraph (3), item (ii) means the purchase of regulated securities, etc., a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) (limited to a transaction in which the person becomes the party to receive money when the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in item (iii) of that paragraph (limited to the transaction in which the person becomes a party to acquire options) and any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(8) The term "highest price during the two weeks after the disclosure set forth in paragraph (1)" as used in paragraph (3), item (ii), (a) means the highest price among the highest prices prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 for each day in the period between the day the disclosure set forth in paragraph (1) is made and the day two weeks have elapsed from the disclosure (when there is no such price, what is specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent, and for the day of the disclosure, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order).
(9) The term "sale, etc. of share certificates, etc." as used in paragraph (4), item (i) means the sale of share certificates, etc., a transaction as set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) (limited to a transaction in which the person becomes the party to pay money when the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in item (iii) of that paragraph (limited to a transaction in which the person becomes the party to grant options) and any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(10) The term "lowest price during the two weeks after the disclosure set forth in paragraph (2)" as used in paragraph (4), item (i), (b) means the lowest price among the lowest prices prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 for each day in the period between the day the disclosure set forth in paragraph (2) is made and the day two weeks have elapsed from the disclosure (when there is no such price, what is specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent, and for the day of the disclosure, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order).
(11) The term "purchase, etc. of share certificates, etc." as used in paragraph (4), item (ii) means the purchase of share certificates, etc., a transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii) (limited to a transaction in which the person becomes the party to receive money when the actual figure exceeds the agreed figure), a transaction set forth in item (iii) of that paragraph (limited to a transaction in which the person becomes the party to acquire options) and any other transaction specified by Cabinet Order.
(12) The term "highest price during the two weeks after the disclosure set forth in paragraph (2)" as used in paragraph (4), item (ii), (a) means the highest price among the highest prices prescribed in Article 67-19 or Article 130 for each day between the period the disclosure set forth in paragraph (2) is made and the day two weeks have elapsed from the disclosure (when there is no such price, what is specified by Cabinet Office Order as being equivalent, and for the day of the disclosure, the amount specified by Cabinet Office Order).
(13) The provisions of paragraph (1) apply mutatis mutandis to the case in which an officer, etc. specified in Article 166, paragraph (1), item (i) of a listed company, etc. has conducted a specified act of providing information, etc. (meaning an act of providing information set forth in Article 167-2, paragraph (1) or recommending the purchase and sale, etc. set forth in that paragraph for the purpose prescribed in that paragraph) as the business of the listed company, etc. In this case, the term "the violator" in paragraph (1) is deemed to be replaced with "the listed company, etc."
(14) The provisions of paragraph (2) apply mutatis mutandis to the case in which an officer, etc. specified in Article 166, paragraph (1), item (i) of a tender offeror, etc. (meaning the tender offeror, etc. prescribed in Article 167, paragraph (1), and including the parent company prescribed in item (i) of that paragraph) has conducted a specified act of providing information, etc. (meaning an act of providing information set forth in Article 167-2, paragraph (2) or recommending the purchase, etc. or the sales, etc. set forth in that paragraph for the purpose prescribed in that paragraph) as the business of the tender offeror, etc. In this case, the term "the violator" in paragraph (2) is deemed to be replaced with "the tender offeror, etc."
(15) Beyond what is prescribed in paragraphs (3) through (12), when the sales, etc. of regulated securities, etc. or the purchase, etc. of regulated securities, etc. prescribed in paragraph (3) or the sales, etc. of share certificates, etc. or the purchase, etc. of share certificates, etc. prescribed in paragraph (4) falls under the transaction set forth in Article 2, paragraph (21), item (ii), the price and volume and any other necessary particulars relevant to the calculation of an administrative monetary penalty set forth in paragraph (1) (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (13)) or paragraph (2) (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to the preceding paragraph) is specified by Cabinet Order.
(Calculation of Fractions for Amount of Administrative Monetary Penalty)
Article 176  (1) It is not permitted to order the payment of an administrative monetary penalty if the amount of the administrative monetary penalty calculated pursuant to the provisions of Articles 172 through the preceding Article is less than ten thousand yen.
(2) If the amount of the administrative monetary penalty calculated pursuant to the provisions of Article 172 through the preceding Article includes an amount that is less than ten thousand yen, the amount is rounded down to the nearest ten thousand yen.
(3) A person that is issued an order under the provisions of Article 172 through the preceding Article must pay the administrative monetary penalty under those provisions.
(4) If a person prescribed in the paragraphs of Article 172; an issuer prescribed in Article 172-2, paragraph (1), (4), or (6); an issuer prescribed in the paragraphs of Article 172-3; an issuer prescribed in Article 172-4, paragraphs (1) through (3); a person prescribed in Article 172-5; a person prescribed in the paragraphs of Article 172-6; a person prescribed in Article 172-7; a person prescribed in Article 172-8; a person prescribed in Article 172-9; an issuer prescribed in Article 172-10, paragraph (1); an issuer prescribed in Article 172-11, paragraph (1) a specified involved person prescribed in Article 172-12, paragraph (1)chou; a violator prescribed in Article 173, paragraph (1); a violator prescribed in Article 174, paragraph (1); a violator prescribed in 174-2, paragraph (1); a violator prescribed in Article 174-3, paragraph (1); a person prescribed in Article 175, paragraph (1), or paragraph (2) of that Article; or a listed company, etc. prescribed in paragraph (9) of that Article, a violator prescribed in paragraph (1) of the preceding Article, a violator prescribed in paragraph (2) of that Article, a listed company, etc. prescribed in paragraph (13) of that Article, or a tender offeror, etc. prescribed in paragraph (14) of that Article is a corporation, and if that corporation disappears in a merger, the acts performed by the corporation that has disappeared are deemed to be acts performed by the corporation that has survived the merger or by the corporation incorporated in the merger, and the provisions of Article 172 through the preceding Article and the preceding three paragraphs apply.
(Dispositions for Conducting Investigations)
Article 177  (1) The Prime Minister may have relevant officials make the following dispositions in order to conduct the necessary investigation into a case concerning an administrative monetary penalty under the provisions of Article 172-12, paragraph (1), Article 173, paragraph (1); Article 174, paragraph (1); Article 174-2, paragraph (1); Article 174-3, paragraph (1); Article 175, paragraph (1) (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (9) of that Article) paragraph (2) of that Article, Article 175-2, paragraph (1) (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (13) of that Article), or paragraph (2) of the Article (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (14) of that Article):
(i) requesting a person concerned in the case or a witness to appear and asking them questions, or obtaining their opinions or reports; and
(ii) ordering a person concerned with a case to submit books, documents, and any other articles, or retaining the submitted articles; and
(iii) entering the business office of a person concerned in the case and other necessary places to inspect the books, documents, and any other articles.
(2) The Prime Minister may make inquiries to public offices or public or private organizations and request them to report necessary particulars with regard to the investigation under the preceding paragraph.
Section 2 Trial Procedures
(Decision to Commence Trial Procedures)
Article 178  (1) If the Prime Minister finds that any of the following facts have occurred, the Prime Minister must issue a decision to commence trial procedures for a case that involves that fact:
(i) a fact that falls under Article 172, paragraph (1) or paragraph (2) (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (4) of that Article) or paragraph (3) of that Article;
(ii) a fact that falls under Article 172-2, paragraph (1) (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (4) of that Article), paragraph (2) of that Article (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (5) of that Article), or paragraph (6) of that Article;
(iii) a fact that falls under any of the paragraphs of Article 172-3;
(iv) a fact that falls under Article 172-4, paragraph (1) or paragraph (2) (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (3) of that Article);
(v) a fact that falls under Article 172-5;
(vi) a fact that falls under Article 172-6, paragraph (1) (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (2) of that Article);
(vii) a fact that falls under Article 172-7;
(viii) a fact that falls under Article 172-8;
(ix) a fact that falls under Article 172-9;
(x) a fact that falls under the paragraphs of Article 172-10;
(xi) a fact that falls under Article 172-11, paragraph (1);
(xi)-2 the fact which falls under Article 172-12, paragraph (1);
(xii) a fact that falls under Article 173, paragraph (1);
(xiii) a fact that falls under Article 174, paragraph (1);
(xiv) a fact that falls under Article 174-2, paragraph (1);
(xv) a fact that falls under Article 174-3, paragraph (1); or
(xvi) a fact that falls under Article 175, paragraph (1) (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (9) of that Article) or paragraph (2) of that Article;
(xvii) a fact which falls under Article 175-2, paragraph (1) (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (13) of that Article) or paragraph (2) of that Article (including as applied mutatis mutandis pursuant to paragraph (14) of that Article).
